beat.means: the film's beat (the beats module): anselm, shrouds, top, letter, gop_bye, secret, sew, rail, raise, helm, arrive, steamer, night_end; null — nothing plays

hour.means: the hour, round the clock, as in the whole world: 0 midnight, 0.25 dawn, 0.5 noon, 0.75 sunset; the ship sails west, to Kaperna: the dawn astern, the sunset ahead

ship.means: whose deck: secret — the white galliot Secret (three masts, square sails on the fore- and mainmast, the spanker furled), anselm — the dark, worn schooner Anselm (two masts, patched fore-and-aft sails, a topsail on the foremast); changed by a cut

storm.means: foul weather: 0 calm, 1 storm — the sky clouded, the light grey, the rolling stronger, whitecaps on the sea, the wind tearing at the sails

roll.means: heel: −1 to port, 0 even, 1 to starboard (up to 12°); the rolling goes on top

sails_set.means: the sails: 0 furled (rolled up on the yards, the upper yards lowered), 1 set and full; they go up one after another — the courses, the topsails, the topgallants (the Anselm's — mainsail, foresail, topsail); with them the ship gets under way: up to 4 m/s

luff.means: the sails luff: 0 full of wind, 1 slack and flapping (and the way falls off)

helm.means: the wheel: −1 hard over to the left, 1 to the right (three quarters of a turn)

heading.means: where the bow points: 0 — west, straight at Kaperna, −1 25° to the left, 1 25° to the right; the ship turns and sails where it points

shore.means: the ship's place on the way to Kaperna (puts her there; from there she goes on under her own way): 0 — 6 km off (a hill on the horizon), 1 — 600 m off (the houses, Longren's house at the top, the cape with the lighthouse); below 0 — further out at sea (−1: 15 km, no land in sight)

port.means: the port of Liss: 1 — the ship lies at the quay (the quay to starboard, the warehouses and the town beyond it), 0 — at sea (where — shore)

lanterns.means: the lanterns: by the ladder from the poop on both sides and on the mainmast

silk.means: scarlet silk in the waist by the lanterns: 0 none, 1 heaps and lengths over the whole deck (they grow one by one)

cask.means: the Grays' cask of wine with mugs amid the poop: 0 none, 1 stands there

steamer.means: the mail steamer: 0 — none; a greater value puts her ahead to starboard of the ship (towards 0 — 420 m, 1 — 70 m ahead and 24 m to starboard), then both go under their own way: the Secret under sail overtakes her

skiff_down.means: the skiff by the starboard side: 0 — hanging under the rail, 1 — lowered onto the water

ropes.means: a close-up of the ship's boy's hands on the shrouds (an insert, the closeups module's shot ropes): 1 — open; on it the points ropes#left, ropes#right

climb.means: the ropes insert: how high the boy has climbed — the ratlines go down (0 — by the deck, 1 — by the crosstrees); moved by the game

hand_l.means: the ropes insert: the left hand — 1 closed on the rope, 0 raised and open; moved by the game

hand_r.means: the ropes insert: the right hand — 1 closed on the rope, 0 raised and open; moved by the game

slip.means: the ropes insert: a slip — the hands slide down the rope (an impulse: 1 and back to 0); moved by the game

leg.means: the play's key: the stage of the way to Kaperna at which the scene is opened with the beat helm (puts the ship as shore does); none (null) — helm comes after raise, from where the ship is

sun.means: the play's key: the morning's hour in the beats raise, helm, arrive (as hour)

wine.means: the play's key: in the beat night_end 1 — the Grays' cask and two sailors by it, 0 — no cask, four sailors sit on the hatch and sing

ring.means: the play's key: Assol's ring on the deck (the beats steamer, night_end) — none, on her finger (a part of the cast by ring_kind), on a cord over the dress (the part ring_cord); none by default

ring_kind.means: the play's key: which ring — mother — his mother's (the part ring), own — his old one (the part ring_old); own by default

day.means: internal: the weight of daylight (sky.follow by hour)

dawn.means: internal: the weight of dawn (sky.follow by hour)

dusk.means: internal: the weight of sunset (sky.follow by hour)

night.means: internal: the weight of night (sky.follow by hour)

sun_light.means: internal: how much the sun shines (sky.follow by hour)

moon_light.means: internal: how much the moon shines (sky.follow by hour)

harbour_lit.means: internal: how brightly the Liss quay lamps burn; the script sets it by the night

heel.means: internal: the ship's tilt, degrees (+ to port): the heel roll and the rolling; the script leads it itself

ship_x.means: internal: where the ship is in the world across the course to Kaperna, m (to the right, northwards); the script leads her under her own way, shore and port set it

ship_d.means: internal: where the ship is in the world along the course west, m: 0 — 6 km from Kaperna, Liss at −30000; the script leads her under her own way, shore and port set it

ship_f.means: internal: the ship's turn, degrees (180 — bow to the west); the script sets it by heading

ship_at.means: internal: which port and shore put the ship where she is (“port:shore”); the script puts the ship anew when they name another place

steamer_at.means: internal: which value of steamer put the steamer where she is

steamer_x.means: internal: where the steamer is in the world across, m; the script sets it by steamer and leads it

steamer_d.means: internal: where the steamer is in the world along the course, m; the script sets it by steamer and leads it

steamer_smoke.means: internal: whether the steamer smokes (1 while she is here)

belly_l.means: internal: the turn of the square sails' left halves, degrees (180 — flat): the edges aft when the wind fills them; the script sets it by sails_set and luff

belly_r.means: internal: the turn of the square sails' right halves, degrees; the script sets it by sails_set and luff

belly_tilt.means: internal: the tilt of the square sails, degrees (−: the foot forward under the wind); the script sets it by sails_set and luff

fore_tg_e.means: internal: where the fore topgallant hangs — the height of its yard, raised above the foot, over the poop, m: it goes up with the topsail yard; the script sets it by sails_set

main_tg_e.means: internal: where the main topgallant hangs, the same; the script sets it by sails_set

lo_a.means: internal: where Longren is — along the steamer, m from her middle (aft); set by the beats

lo_d.means: internal: where Longren is — across the steamer, m from her port side inwards; set by the beats

lo_e.means: internal: the height of the steamer's deck under Longren above the water, m

prompts.text: Wide ambient strings over a slow sea swell, wind in the rigging, modern indie game score, hopeful
Four rising notes on solo violin, then the orchestra taking them up, scarlet sails filling at dawn
Creaking timber and rope textures turned into soft percussion, a ship working under sail
Low cello pulse like a hull rising and falling, steady, determined
Sea shanty melody slowed down on a lone concertina, night watch, lanterns
Gypsy violin, warm and free, a musician playing on deck at night
Storm: driving low strings and timpani, spray and wind, tense but not dark
Shimmering harp and celesta, sun on the water, calm sailing
Full romantic orchestra swelling, horns and strings, arrival, joy
Minimal piano and soft synth pad, a young man reading a letter in a quiet harbour
Fiddles tuning, a few bars tried and dropped, scissors and silk rustle, night in port
Brass band far away on a steamer's deck, faint and festive
Airy wordless choir on the wind, the open sea at dawn
Rhythmic bowed bass and handclaps, a crew hauling sails up together
Lonely flute over open fifths, the mast top, the horizon all round
Glassy pads and slow guitar harmonics, moonlit deck, two people at the rail
Accordion waltz at night, an old cask opened, wine for paradise
Steady marimba ostinato with strings, holding the course straight
Deep foghorn-like synth swells, grey calm port morning
